source.scope: DOS manual only; paraphrased inventory, no historical substitutions.
source.page_mapping: Printed page = 1-based PDF page minus 4 for numbered main text.

missions.name: The Mossel Defense
missions.description: Soviet forces have broken Allied defenses and approach the Mossel River in successive waves.
missions.primary_objective: Survive and destroy every attacking Soviet vehicle.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: Siegen Infiltration
missions.description: Supply convoys from Essen have disappeared near hilly Siegen. Intelligence suggests one or possibly two Soviet bases; Hind sightings remain unconfirmed in the briefing.
missions.primary_objective: Find and destroy the Soviet base or bases.
hazards: Hilly terrain permits ground and air ambushes.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: Nuremberg Highway
missions.description: An Allied base has lost resupply; two convoys failed to arrive. Intelligence reports heavy ATGW activity in roadside hills.
missions.primary_objective: Clear all Soviet forces along the highway and reopen the supply route.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: Mass Destruction
missions.description: Soviet troops approach from north and west, threatening the M1 base near the Emes River.
missions.primary_objective: Destroy all three nearby enemy bases.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: The Road to Bonn
missions.description: After Frankfurt falls, Soviet armor moves toward Bonn. The Mainz bridge offers passage across the Rhine around Allied forces at Koblenz.
missions.secondary_objective: Destroy as much of the Soviet reconnaissance team as possible.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: Hannover Push
missions.description: Soviet forces have overrun Hannover and amassed weapons and vehicles for an attack toward Cologne. A communications fort lies east of their base.
missions.secondary_objective: Find and eliminate the communications fort.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: Convoy
missions.description: Soviet attacks threaten civilian relief supplies moving through Siegen toward Weller.
missions.primary_objective: Escort and protect the five-truck convoy until it reaches Allied Base Weller across the Rhine.
missions.restriction: Protect all five trucks throughout the journey.
missions.narrative_follow_on: Supplies are transferred to cargo aircraft for relief airdrops.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

missions.name: The Mossel Intercept
missions.description: Damaged Allied vehicles lie west of the player, across the Mossel, after defeating a Soviet reconnaissance group. A powerful Soviet patrol approaches southward along the river.
missions.primary_objective: Reach the damaged Allied vehicles before the Soviet patrol, then escort them to your base.
missions.loadout: Player chooses ammunition mix and governor in the Motor Pool; no mission-specific compulsory loadout stated.

training.description: No separately named training missions in this manual. Scenario play is described as command training, with selectable mission, skill and day/night.

vehicles.name: ACRV-2
vehicles.description: Tracked mobile command post; intended to operate away from the front line.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: BMP-1
vehicles.description: Combat-capable infantry carrier with a crew of three and room for nine infantry.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: BMP-2
vehicles.description: BMP-1 development with a larger turret, a 30mm cannon, 7.62mm coaxial gun and Spandrel ATGW.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.
vehicles.source_discrepancy: Table says 30mm MG; prose calls it a 30mm cannon and separately lists a 7.62mm coaxial gun. Both are retained.

vehicles.name: BRDM-2
vehicles.description: Wheeled reconnaissance or tank-destroyer vehicle; reconnaissance versions generally omit ATGWs.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: BRDM-3
vehicles.description: BRDM-2 development replacing Sagger with the more powerful Spandrel.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: BTR
vehicles.description: Amphibious wheeled Warsaw Pact transport; two crew and up to nine passengers; thin armor discourages combat.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: FST-1
vehicles.description: Manual describes Soviet field trials and explicitly treats turretless construction, automatic loader, thermal blinder and two-person crew as beliefs or rumors.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.
vehicles.unknown_fields: Weight, dimensions, maximum speed and secondary armament explicitly unknown; picture unavailable.

vehicles.name: M113
vehicles.description: US Army troop transport; reliable and practical, with less armor than an IFV.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: M1A1 Abrams
vehicles.description: Player tank, with Rheinmetall cannon, Chobham armor and thermal imaging.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

speed_notes.name: Governor
speed_notes.description: Operations states approximately 72km/h governed or 100km/h ungoverned, with overheating and permanent engine failure possible when ungoverned; off-road speeds are lower.

vehicles.name: M2 Bradley
vehicles.description: M1 infantry-team partner engaging softer targets and spotting or destroying anti-tank weapons; more mobile, better armed and better protected than M113.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: M60A3
vehicles.description: M60 development with slower speed and a higher profile than newer tanks; manual contrasts it unfavorably with T-80.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.
vehicles.source_note: The surprising six-round primary capacity and 750m range are visually confirmed in the printed manual, not OCR guesses.

vehicles.name: Mi-24 Hind
vehicles.description: Large, fast armed helicopter carrying eight equipped troops and anti-tank guided weapons.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: T-62
vehicles.description: T-54/55 development; considered outclassed by newer tanks in the manual.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: T-64
vehicles.description: Introduces a 125mm gun and automatic loader, reducing crew to three.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

vehicles.name: T-72
vehicles.description: Principal Soviet MBT in the manual; stabilized gun allows some moving fire, with dispersion problems beyond 1000m.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.
vehicles.source_note: Manual calls T-72 also T-74; retained as a manual-era alias, not independently validated history.

vehicles.name: T-80
vehicles.description: T-64 evolution with a 1000hp turbine, improved suspension, laser rangefinder, anti-PGM electronics and reactive-armor retrofit.
vehicles.allegiance_basis: US or Soviet flag beside entry, reinforced by description.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Allied supply trucks
other_units_and_objectives.description: Convoy objective consists of five friendly trucks; no model, armament or performance figures supplied.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Damaged Allied vehicles
other_units_and_objectives.description: Rescue and escort objective; the manual does not specify their models or count.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Cargo aircraft
other_units_and_objectives.description: Mentioned as relief-supply airlift after convoy arrival; no model or specifications and no assertion of simulated controllable aircraft.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Air scouts
other_units_and_objectives.description: Report incoming patrol in Mossel Intercept; no aircraft type or simulation role stated.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Infantry ATGW teams
other_units_and_objectives.description: Guided missiles may be vehicle-mounted or operated by infantry on the ground; most guidance uses wires.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Soviet reconnaissance group / patrol
other_units_and_objectives.description: Reconnaissance units threaten Bonn and damaged Allied vehicles; composition and exact vehicle count not stated.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Allied base
other_units_and_objectives.description: Each mission has at least one, player starts nearby; unlimited returns permit ammunition replacement, refueling and governor changes.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Soviet bases
other_units_and_objectives.description: Destruction objectives for Siegen, Mass Destruction and Hannover; Mass Destruction explicitly requires three.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Communications fort
other_units_and_objectives.description: Eastern Hannover link coordinating Soviet forces; secondary destruction objective.

other_units_and_objectives.name: Mainz bridge
other_units_and_objectives.description: Neutral infrastructure designated primary destruction objective in Road to Bonn.

anti_tank_guided_weapons.name: AT-3 Sagger
anti_tank_guided_weapons.description: Infantry-operated anti-tank missile, also mounted on BMP-1 and BRDM-2.

anti_tank_guided_weapons.name: AT-5 Spandrel
anti_tank_guided_weapons.description: More effective than Sagger; mounted on BRDM-3 and BMP-2.

anti_tank_guided_weapons.name: AT-6 Spiral
anti_tank_guided_weapons.description: Manual describes a large laser-guided weapon on Hind-D helicopters.

anti_tank_guided_weapons.name: TOW
anti_tank_guided_weapons.description: US wire-guided anti-tank weapon: operator maintains sight on target. Bradley primary weapon.

ammunition_and_armament.name: Sabot
ammunition_and_armament.description: Armor-piercing kinetic dart; very effective against armor, ineffective against infantry, structures and aircraft.

ammunition_and_armament.name: HEAT
ammunition_and_armament.description: Shaped-charge round; very effective against infantry and structures, effective against armor, ineffective against aircraft.

ammunition_and_armament.name: AX
ammunition_and_armament.description: Experimental anti-helicopter/anti-armor round; slower loading because of shell size and wire guidance; strongest against aircraft, somewhat effective against other targets at extended range.

ammunition_and_armament.name: COAX
ammunition_and_armament.description: Machine gun with quick loading independent of main rounds; mildly effective against infantry and very light armor, marginal or ineffective against aircraft.

ammunition_and_armament.name: 120mm Rheinmetall cannon
ammunition_and_armament.description: Fires HEAT, sabot and AX; performance depends on selected ammunition.

ammunition_and_armament.name: Smoke discharger
ammunition_and_armament.description: Defensive concealment against enemies lacking thermal imaging and sight-guided missiles such as Sagger and Spigot; effect approximately twenty seconds.

keyboard_controls.name: A
keyboard_controls.description: Align turret with the front of the hull.

keyboard_controls.name: C
keyboard_controls.description: Switch movement control between hull and turret.

keyboard_controls.name: L
keyboard_controls.description: Lock crosshairs onto the currently selected target.

keyboard_controls.name: M
keyboard_controls.description: Fire machine gun.

keyboard_controls.name: S
keyboard_controls.description: Discharge smoke canisters.
Ready HEAT.
Ready sabot.
Ready AX.

keyboard_controls.name: Enter
keyboard_controls.description: Cycle available targets with the TADS box; after the final target the box turns off.

keyboard_controls.name: Space
keyboard_controls.description: Fire selected weapon.

keyboard_controls.name: R
keyboard_controls.description: Retrieve pending radio message; no effect when no message is waiting.

keyboard_controls.name: T
keyboard_controls.description: Toggle thermal imaging.

keyboard_controls.name: Z
keyboard_controls.description: Cycle normal 1x, 3x and 10x sight magnification.

keyboard_controls.name: Z
keyboard_controls.description: Alternate between full territory map and local close-up.

keyboard_controls.name: D
keyboard_controls.description: Show system damage screen; any key returns to commander station.

keyboard_controls.name: F7
keyboard_controls.description: Return scan to original/current turret bearing.

keyboard_controls.name: F8
keyboard_controls.description: Scan 90 degrees clockwise from turret bearing.

keyboard_controls.name: F9
keyboard_controls.description: Scan 180 degrees from turret bearing.

keyboard_controls.name: F10
keyboard_controls.description: Scan 270 degrees clockwise from turret bearing.

keyboard_controls.name: Q
keyboard_controls.description: Open quit sequence for scenario or campaign; continuation option cancels quit.

keyboard_controls.name: F1
keyboard_controls.description: Select gunner station.

keyboard_controls.name: F2
keyboard_controls.description: Select tank commander station.

keyboard_controls.name: F3
keyboard_controls.description: Select cupola view.

keyboard_controls.name: F4
keyboard_controls.description: Select driver station.

keyboard_controls.name: F5
keyboard_controls.description: Toggle sound.

keyboard_controls.name: Shift+3
keyboard_controls.description: Change system speed among slow, medium and fast; fast is the load default.

keyboard_controls.name: Esc
keyboard_controls.description: Back out of menu selection; during a scenario pause, then press any key to resume.

keyboard_controls.name: Keypad 2 / Down
keyboard_controls.description: Move backward in hull mode; lower sight in turret mode.

keyboard_controls.name: Keypad 4 / Left
keyboard_controls.description: Turn hull or turret left; decrease selected ammunition mix in Motor Pool.

keyboard_controls.name: Keypad 5
keyboard_controls.description: Stop hull or turret movement.

keyboard_controls.name: Keypad 6 / Right
keyboard_controls.description: Turn hull or turret right; increase selected ammunition mix in Motor Pool.

keyboard_controls.name: Keypad 8 / Up
keyboard_controls.description: Move forward in hull mode; raise sight in turret mode.

keyboard_controls.name: Enter
keyboard_controls.description: Cycle highlighted mission, DAY/NIGHT or NOVICE/MODERATE/EXPERT options; submit campaign name or vehicle identification.

keyboard_controls.name: Space
keyboard_controls.description: Advance past mission-title screen.

keyboard_controls.name: Enter
keyboard_controls.description: Advance timed presentation screens such as credits or Colonel Wilson briefing.

stations.name: Gunner
stations.description: Target acquisition, identification, firing, magnified sight and thermal imaging.

stations.name: Tank commander
stations.description: Strategy, overhead map, 360-degree periscope scan and damage information.

stations.name: Cupola
stations.description: Hatch-level outside view, particularly useful for airborne threats.

stations.name: Driver
stations.description: Navigation view with heading, speed, fuel and temperature.

stations.name: Loader
stations.description: Automatic ammunition loading, with no player-view screen.

campaign.name: Full campaign
campaign.description: All eight scenarios; settings determined by fate. Name up to eight characters, automatic campaign saving, continue/review/erase options.

uncertainties.detail: Table calls it MG, prose cannon; no external correction applied.
Unknown specs and rumored features preserved.
Printed spellings retained rather than silently corrected to real-world geography.

joystick.name: Joystick
joystick.description: Forward/backward and left/right control motion; one button stops and another fires. Button numbers unspecified.
